style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and lineup shots, cool ice-blue studio backdrop #D3E8F5 fading to #FFFFFF for benefit and info shots, deeper sky-blue wall #7FB6D9 with soft leaf-shadow light patterns for the lifestyle scene

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh aqua summer skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, cool ice-blue backdrop #D3E8F5, deep sky-blue #7FB6D9, charcoal text #2D3238 and one warm gold accent #E8871E; cool-toned airy studio daylight with a soft top-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headline typography in charcoal; consistent rounded rectangular info labels and thin-line circular icons in the gold accent; clean high-end sunscreen photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright product scale and placement with clean balanced composition; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable upright slight 3/4 hero angle and stable product scale; treat the tall bottle form and the slim tube form as one product family and keep the white body with the gold cap reading identically across the whole set
